description: This file defines a mock class 'MockINetworkManager' for the interface 'INetworkManager' used in testing. It provides mocked implementations for various network management functions such as interface configuration, WiFi operations, IP settings, connectivity, and logging.

classes.name: MockINetworkManager
classes.description: A mock class implementing the INetworkManager interface for unit testing, providing mock methods for network operations.

methods.name: GetAvailableInterfaces
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of available network interfaces.

methods.name: GetPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Mocks getting the primary network interface.

methods.name: SetInterfaceState
methods.description: Mocks enabling or disabling a network interface.

methods.name: GetInterfaceState
methods.description: Mocks querying the state of a network interface.

methods.name: GetIPSettings
methods.description: Mocks obtaining IP settings for an interface.

methods.name: SetIPSettings
methods.description: Mocks setting IP configuration for an interface.

methods.name: GetStunEndpoint
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the STUN server endpoint.

methods.name: SetStunEndpoint
methods.description: Mocks configuring the STUN server endpoint.

methods.name: GetConnectivityTestEndpoints

methods.description: Mocks setting endpoints for connectivity testing.

methods.name: IsConnectedToInternet

methods.name: GetCaptivePortalURI

methods.name: GetPublicIP
